prompt: Deconstruct the theme keywords into giant hollow single-line glyphs and guiding strokes. The lines span the entire frame and weave between the foreground and background of the main subject. The glyph interiors remain transparent, allowing the background and subject to be visible. Use uniform line thickness, right-angle turns, long arcs, arrow endpoints, and dot nodes to form a reading path from the top title to the central subject and then to the bottom info area, appearing like both text and a roadmap. A small amount of body text should be divided into clean sans-serif blocks, placed near character white space or on both sides of the subject, with clear hierarchy. Small info tags and signatures can be at the bottom. All text serves the rhythm and scale without overpowering the main subject.\n\nText: I give my heart to the moon

promptZh:
将主题关键词解构为巨大的空心单线字形和引导笔触。线条跨越整个画面，并在主体的前景与背景之间穿梭。字形内部保持透明，以便显现背景和主体。使用统一的线条粗细、直角转折、长弧线、箭头端点和圆点节点，形成从顶部标题到中心主体，再到底部信息区域的阅读路径，使其既像文字又像路线图。少量正文应划分为整洁的无衬线字体块，放置在角色留白处或主体两侧，并具有清晰的层级。底部可放置小型信息标签和签名。所有文本均服务于节奏和比例，且不会喧宾夺主。

文本：I give my heart to the moon
